data "aws_iam_policy_document" "this" {
  statement {
    sid    = "SecHubDelegatingOrgReadActions"
    effect = "Allow"

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.audit_account_id}:root"]
    }
    actions   = ["organizations:ListRoots"]
    resources = ["*"] //ListRoots only support * in resource section
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SecHubDelegatingNecessaryOrgManagementActions"
    effect = "Allow"

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.audit_account_id}:root"]
    }

    actions = [
      "organizations:DescribeOrganization",
      "organizations:DescribeOrganizationalUnit",
      "organizations:DescribeAccount",
      "organizations:ListRoots",
      "organizations:ListOrganizationalUnitsForParent",
      "organizations:ListParents",
      "organizations:ListChildren",
      "organizations:ListAccounts",
      "organizations:ListAccountsForParent",
      "organizations:ListTagsForResource",
      "organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators",
      "organizations:ListHandshakesForAccount"
    ]

    resources = [
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:root/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:organization/${local.org_id}",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:ou/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:account/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:policy/${local.org_id}/securityhub_policy/*"
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SecHubDelegatingPolicyDescribeActions"
    effect = "Allow"

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.audit_account_id}:root"]
    }

    actions = [
      "organizations:DescribePolicy",
      "organizations:DescribeEffectivePolicy",
      "organizations:ListPolicies",
      "organizations:ListPoliciesForTarget",
      "organizations:ListTargetsForPolicy"
    ]

    resources = [
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:root/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:ou/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:account/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:policy/${local.org_id}/securityhub_policy/*"
    ]
  }

  # condition key for organizations:PolicyType because. The resource ARNs are scoped
  # to securityhub_policy/* paths as the mitigating control.
  statement {
    sid    = "SecHubDelegatingPolicyMutationActions"
    effect = "Allow"

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.audit_account_id}:root"]
    }

    actions = [
      "organizations:CreatePolicy",
      "organizations:UpdatePolicy",
      "organizations:DeletePolicy",
      "organizations:AttachPolicy",
      "organizations:DetachPolicy",
      "organizations:EnablePolicyType",
      "organizations:DisablePolicyType"
    ]

    resources = [
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:root/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:ou/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:account/${local.org_id}/*",
      "arn:aws:organizations::${var.control_tower_account}:policy/${local.org_id}/securityhub_policy/*"
    ]
  }

    sid    = "SecHubDelegatingPolicyTagActions"
    effect = "Allow"

      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.audit_account_id}:root"]
